verses.en: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!
verses.zh: 无能的人蒙你何等的帮助！膀臂无力的人蒙你何等的拯救！

words.g: to surround, i.e. protect or aid
to be open, wide or free

verses.en: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!
verses.zh: 无智慧的人蒙你何等的指教！你向他多显大知识！

words.g: and + support or  ability, i.e.  help

verses.en: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?
verses.zh: 你向谁发出言语来？谁的灵从你而出？

verses.en: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.
verses.zh: 在大水和水族以下的阴魂战兢。

words.g: to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance
and + to reside or permanently stay + +them/their

verses.en: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.
verses.zh: 在神面前，阴间显露；灭亡也不得遮掩。

verses.en: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.
verses.zh: 神将北极铺在空中，将大地悬在虚空；

verses.en: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.
verses.zh: 将水包在密云中，云却不破裂；

words.g: a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud

verses.en: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.
verses.zh: 遮蔽他的宝座，将云铺在其上；

words.g: a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud + +him/his/it

verses.en: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.
verses.zh: 在水面的周围划出界限，直到光明黑暗的交界。

verses.en: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.
verses.zh: 天的柱子因他的斥责震动惊奇。

verses.en: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.
verses.zh: 他以能力搅动（或译：平静）大海；他藉知识打伤拉哈伯，

verses.en: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.
verses.zh: 藉他的灵使天有妆饰；他的手刺杀快蛇。

verses.en: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”
verses.zh: 看哪，这不过是神工作的些微；我们所听于他的是何等细微的声音！他大能的雷声谁能明透呢？

verses.en: Job again took up his parable, and said,
verses.zh: 约伯接着说：

words.g: Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience
a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature + +him/his/it

verses.en: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter
verses.zh: 神夺去我的理，全能者使我心中愁苦。我指着永生的神起誓：

verses.en: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);
verses.zh: 我的生命尚在我里面；神所赐呼吸之气仍在我的鼻孔内。

verses.en: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.
verses.zh: 我的嘴决不说非义之言；我的舌也不说诡诈之语。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
verses.zh: 我断不以你们为是；我至死必不以自己为不正！

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.
verses.zh: 我持定我的义，必不放松；在世的日子，我心必不责备我。

words.g: to pull off, i.e.  to expose

verses.en: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.
verses.zh: 愿我的仇敌如恶人一样；愿那起来攻击我的，如不义之人一般。

verses.en: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
verses.zh: 不敬虔的人虽然得利，神夺取其命的时候还有甚么指望呢？

words.g: to draw out or off, i.e. remove

verses.en: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?
verses.zh: 患难临到他，神岂能听他的呼求？

verses.en: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?
verses.zh: 他岂以全能者为乐，随时求告神呢？

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
to be soft or pliable, i.e.  effeminate or luxurious

verses.en: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.
verses.zh: 神的作为，我要指教你们；全能者所行的，我也不隐瞒。

words.g: to secrete, by act or word

verses.en: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?
verses.zh: 你们自己也都见过，为何全然变为虚妄呢？

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
to be vain in act, word

verses.en: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.
verses.zh: 神为恶人所定的分，强暴人从全能者所得的报（原文是产业）乃是这样：

verses.en: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.
verses.zh: 倘或他的儿女增多，还是被刀所杀；他的子孙必不得饱食。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.
verses.zh: 他所遗留的人必死而埋葬；他的寡妇也不哀哭。

verses.en: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
verses.zh: 他虽积蓄银子如尘沙，预备衣服如泥土；

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
and + like + a bubbling up, i.e. of water

verses.en: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.
verses.zh: 他只管预备，义人却要穿上；他的银子，无辜的人要分取。

verses.en: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.
verses.zh: 他建造房屋如虫做窝，又如守望者所搭的棚。

words.g: to guard, in a good sense  or a bad one

verses.en: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.
verses.zh: 他虽富足躺卧，却不得收殓，转眼之间就不在了。

verses.en: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.
verses.zh: 惊恐如波涛将他追上；暴风在夜间将他刮去。

verses.en: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.
verses.zh: 东风把他飘去，又刮他离开本处。

verses.en: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.
verses.zh: 神要向他射箭，并不留情；他恨不得逃脱神的手。

verses.en: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.
verses.zh: 人要向他拍掌，并要发叱声，使他离开本处。

words.g: and + to be shrill, i.e. to whistle or hiss

verses.en: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.
verses.zh: 银子有矿；炼金有方。

words.g: a going forth, i.e.  an egress

verses.en: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.
verses.zh: 铁从地里挖出；铜从石中熔化。

verses.en: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.
verses.zh: 人为黑暗定界限，查究幽暗阴翳的石头，直到极处，

verses.en: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.
verses.zh: 在无人居住之处刨开矿穴，过路的人也想不到他们；又与人远离，悬在空中摇来摇去。

words.g: a stream, especially a winter torrent
to turn aside from the road , i.e. sojourn
the + to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of
to waver, in a great variety of applications

verses.en: As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.
verses.zh: 至于地，能出粮食，地内好像被火翻起来。

words.g: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as

verses.en: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.
verses.zh: 地中的石头有蓝宝石，并有金沙。

verses.en: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.
verses.zh: 矿中的路鸷鸟不得知道；鹰眼也未见过。

words.g: a hawk or other bird of prey

verses.en: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.
verses.zh: 狂傲的野兽未曾行过；猛烈的狮子也未曾经过。

words.g: to advance, i.e. pass on or continue

verses.en: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.
verses.zh: 人伸手凿开坚石，倾倒山根，

verses.en: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.
verses.zh: 在磐石中凿出水道，亲眼看见各样宝物。

verses.en: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.
verses.zh: 他封闭水不得滴流，使隐藏的物显露出来。

verses.en: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?
verses.zh: 然而，智慧有何处可寻？聪明之处在哪里呢？

verses.en: Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.
verses.zh: 智慧的价值无人能知，在活人之地也无处可寻。

verses.en: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’
verses.zh: 深渊说：不在我内；沧海说：不在我中。

verses.en: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.
verses.zh: 智慧非用黄金可得，也不能平白银为它的价值。

verses.en: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
verses.zh: 俄斐金和贵重的红玛瑙，并蓝宝石，不足与较量；

words.g: in + something carved out, i.e. ore
Ophir, the name of a son of Joktan
in + a gem, probably the beryl
and + a gem , probably the sapphire

verses.en: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.
verses.zh: 黄金和玻璃不足与比较；精金的器皿不足与兑换。

words.g: to set in a row, i.e. arrange + +her/its

verses.en: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
verses.zh: 珊瑚、水晶都不足论；智慧的价值胜过珍珠（或译：红宝石）。

words.g: something high in value, i.e. perhaps coral

verses.en: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.
verses.zh: 古实的红璧玺不足与比较；精金也不足与较量。

words.g: to set in a row, i.e. arrange + +her/its
Cush , the name of a son of Ham
in + something carved out, i.e. ore

verses.en: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?
verses.zh: 智慧从何处来呢？聪明之处在哪里呢？

verses.en: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.
verses.zh: 是向一切有生命的眼目隐藏，向空中的飞鸟掩蔽。

words.g: and + to veil from sight, i.e. conceal

verses.en: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’
verses.zh: 灭没和死亡说：我们风闻其名。

verses.en: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.
verses.zh: 神明白智慧的道路，晓得智慧的所在。

verses.en: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.
verses.zh: 因他鉴察直到地极，遍观普天之下，

verses.en: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.
verses.zh: 要为风定轻重，又度量诸水；

words.g: in + extension, i.e. height or breadth

verses.en: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,
verses.zh: 他为雨露定命令，为雷电定道路。

verses.en: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.
verses.zh: 那时他看见智慧，而且述说；他坚定，并且查究。

words.g: and + to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe + +her/its

verses.en: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”
verses.zh: 他对人说：敬畏主就是智慧；远离恶便是聪明。

verses.en: Job again took up his parable, and said,
verses.zh: 约伯又接着说：

words.g: Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience
a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature + +him/his/it

verses.en: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;
verses.zh: 惟愿我的景况如从前的月份，如神保守我的日子。

verses.en: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,
verses.zh: 那时他的灯照在我头上；我藉他的光行过黑暗。

verses.en: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,
verses.zh: 我愿如壮年的时候：那时我在帐棚中，神待我有密友之情；

words.g: the crop gathered, i.e.  the autumn  season + +me/my

verses.en: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,
verses.zh: 全能者仍与我同在；我的儿女都环绕我。

words.g: a boy , from the age of infancy to adolescence + +me/my

verses.en: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,
verses.zh: 奶多可洗我的脚；磐石为我出油成河。

verses.en: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.
verses.zh: 我出到城门，在街上设立座位；

words.g: in + a width, i.e.  avenue or area

verses.en: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.
verses.zh: 少年人见我而回避，老年人也起身站立；

words.g: a boy , from the age of infancy to adolescence

verses.en: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
verses.zh: 王子都停止说话，用手捂口；

words.g: to + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +them/their

verses.en: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.
verses.zh: 首领静默无声，舌头贴住上膛。

words.g: to + the palate or inside of the mouth + +them/their
to impinge, i.e. cling or adhere

verses.en: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,
verses.zh: 耳朵听我的，就称我有福；眼睛看我的，便称赞我；

verses.en: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
verses.zh: 因我拯救哀求的困苦人和无人帮助的孤儿。

words.g: to be smooth, i.e.  to escape
to surround, i.e. protect or aid

verses.en: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
verses.zh: 将要灭亡的为我祝福；我也使寡妇心中欢乐。

verses.en: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.
verses.zh: 我以公义为衣服，以公平为外袍和冠冕。

verses.en: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.
verses.zh: 我为瞎子的眼，瘸子的脚。

verses.en: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.
verses.zh: 我为穷乏人的父；素不认识的人，我查明他的案件。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate

verses.en: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.
verses.zh: 我打破不义之人的牙床，从他牙齿中夺了所抢的。

verses.en: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.
verses.zh: 我便说：我必死在家中（原文是窝中），必增添我的日子，多如尘沙。

words.g: a nest , sometimes including the nestlings + +me/my

verses.en: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.
verses.zh: 我的根长到水边；露水终夜沾在我的枝上。

verses.en: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’
verses.zh: 我的荣耀在身上增新；我的弓在手中日强。

words.g: weight, but only figuratively in a good sense + +me/my
and + a bow, forshooting  or the iris + +me/my
to slide by, i.e.  to hasten away

verses.en: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.
verses.zh: 人听见我而仰望，静默等候我的指教。

verses.en: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.
verses.zh: 我说话之后，他们就不再说；我的言语像雨露滴在他们身上。

verses.en: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.
verses.zh: 他们仰望我如仰望雨，又张开口如切慕春雨。

words.g: and + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +them/their

verses.en: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.
verses.zh: 他们不敢自信，我就向他们含笑；他们不使我脸上的光改变。

verses.en: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.
verses.zh: 我为他们选择道路，又坐首位；我如君王在军队中居住，又如吊丧的安慰伤心的人。

words.g: and + to reside or permanently stay

verses.en: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.
verses.zh: 但如今，比我年少的人戏笑我；其人之父我曾藐视，不肯安在看守我羊群的狗中。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +them/their

verses.en: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?
verses.zh: 他们壮年的气力既已衰败，其手之力与我何益呢？

verses.en: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.
verses.zh: 他们因穷乏饥饿，身体枯瘦，在荒废凄凉的幽暗中，龈干燥之地，

verses.en: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.
verses.zh: 在草丛之中采咸草，罗腾（小树名，松类）的根为他们的食物。

verses.en: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,
verses.zh: 他们从人中被赶出；人追喊他们如贼一般，

verses.en: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.
verses.zh: 以致他们住在荒谷之间，在地洞和岩穴中；

words.g: in + feared, i.e.  a horrible place or chasm
a stream, especially a winter torrent
to + to reside or permanently stay

verses.en: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.
verses.zh: 在草丛中叫唤，在荆棘下聚集。

words.g: pointed, i.e. a bramble or other thorny weed
to scrape out, but in certain peculiar senses

verses.en: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.
verses.zh: 这都是愚顽下贱人的儿女；他们被鞭打，赶出境外。

verses.en: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.
verses.zh: 现在这些人以我为歌曲，以我为笑谈。

verses.en: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.
verses.zh: 他们厌恶我，躲在旁边站着，不住地吐唾沫在我脸上。

words.g: to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove

verses.en: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.
verses.zh: 松开他们的绳索苦待我，在我面前脱去辔头。

verses.en: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.
verses.zh: 这等下流人在我右边起来，推开我的脚，筑成战路来攻击我。

verses.en: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.
verses.zh: 这些无人帮助的，毁坏我的道，加增我的灾。

words.g: to surround, i.e. protect or aid

verses.en: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.
verses.zh: 他们来如同闯进大破口，在毁坏之间滚在我身上。

verses.en: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.
verses.zh: 惊恐临到我，驱逐我的尊荣如风；我的福禄如云过去。

words.g: and + like + an envelope, i.e. darkness

verses.en: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.
verses.zh: 现在我心极其悲伤；困苦的日子将我抓住。

verses.en: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.
verses.zh: 夜间，我里面的骨头刺我，疼痛不止，好像龈我。

verses.en: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.
verses.zh: 因神的大力，我的外衣污秽不堪，又如里衣的领子将我缠住。

verses.en: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.
verses.zh: 神嘘气成冰；宽阔之水也都凝结。

verses.en: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.
verses.zh: 他使密云盛满水气，布散电光之云；

words.g: to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively
a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud

verses.en: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,
verses.zh: 这云是藉他的指引游行旋转，得以在全地面上行他一切所吩咐的，

words.g: in + steerage , i.e.  guidance or  a plan + +him/his/it

verses.en: whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.
verses.zh: 或为责罚，或为润地，或为施行慈爱。

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
verses.zh: 约伯啊，你要留心听，要站立思想神奇妙的作为。

words.g: to broaden out the ear , i.e.  to listen
Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience
and + to separate mentally , i.e. understand

verses.en: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?
verses.zh: 神如何吩咐这些，如何使云中的电光照耀，你知道吗？

words.g: a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud + +him/his/it

verses.en: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?
verses.zh: 云彩如何浮于空中，那知识全备者奇妙的作为，你知道吗？

verses.en: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?
verses.zh: 南风使地寂静，你的衣服就如火热，你知道吗？

verses.en: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?
verses.zh: 你岂能与神同铺穹苍吗？这穹苍坚硬，如同铸成的镜子。

verses.en: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.
verses.zh: 我们愚昧不能陈说；请你指教我们该对他说甚么话。

words.g: to set in a row, i.e. arrange

verses.en: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?
verses.zh: 人岂可说：我愿与他说话？岂有人自愿灭亡吗？

words.g: the + to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.
verses.zh: 现在有云遮蔽，人不得见穹苍的光亮；但风吹过，天又发晴。

verses.en: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.
verses.zh: 金光出于北方，在神那里有可怕的威严。

verses.en: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.
verses.zh: 论到全能者，我们不能测度；他大有能力，有公平和大义，必不苦待人。

verses.en: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”
verses.zh: 所以，人敬畏他；凡自以为心中有智慧的人，他都不顾念。

verses.en: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind,
verses.zh: 那时，耶和华从旋风中回答约伯说：

words.g: Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience

verses.en: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
verses.zh: 谁用无知的言语使我的旨意暗昧不明？

verses.en: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!
verses.zh: 你要如勇士束腰；我问你，你可以指示我。

words.g: like + a valiant man or warrior

verses.en: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
verses.zh: 我立大地根基的时候，你在哪里呢？你若有聪明，只管说吧！

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?
verses.zh: 你若晓得就说，是谁定地的尺度？是谁把准绳拉在其上？

verses.en: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,
verses.zh: 地的根基安置在何处？地的角石是谁安放的？

verses.en: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verses.zh: 那时，晨星一同歌唱；神的众子也都欢呼。

words.g: in + to creak , i.e. to shout

verses.en: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
verses.zh: 海水冲出，如出胎胞，那时谁将它关闭呢？

words.g: in + something swinging, i.e. the valve of adoor
in + to gush forth , generally to issue + +him/his/it

verses.en: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,
verses.zh: 是我用云彩当海的衣服，用幽暗当包裹它的布，

words.g: a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud

verses.en: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,
verses.zh: 为它定界限，又安门和闩，

words.g: and + something swinging, i.e. the valve of adoor

verses.en: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?
verses.zh: 说：你只可到这里，不可越过；你狂傲的浪要到此止住。

words.g: this place , i.e. here or hence
and + this place , i.e. here or hence

verses.en: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,
verses.zh: 你自生以来，曾命定晨光，使清晨的日光知道本位，

verses.en: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?
verses.zh: 叫这光普照地的四极，将恶人从其中驱逐出来吗？

verses.en: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.
verses.zh: 因这光，地面改变如泥上印印，万物出现如衣服一样。

words.g: like + a bubbling up, i.e. of water
a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as

verses.en: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.
verses.zh: 亮光不照恶人；强横的膀臂也必折断。

words.g: and + to debar  from benefit or injury
and + the arm , or  the foreleg
to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?
verses.zh: 你曾进到海源，或在深渊的隐密处行走吗？

verses.en: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?
verses.zh: 死亡的门曾向你显露吗？死荫的门你曾见过吗？

verses.en: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.
verses.zh: 地的广大你能明透吗？你若全知道，只管说吧！

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,
verses.zh: 光明的居所从何而至？黑暗的本位在于何处？

verses.en: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?
verses.zh: 你能带到本境，能看明其室之路吗？

verses.en: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
verses.zh: 你总知道，因为你早已生在世上，你日子的数目也多。

words.g: and + a number, definite  or indefinite

verses.en: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,
verses.zh: 你曾进入雪库，或见过雹仓吗？

verses.en: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
verses.zh: 这雪雹乃是我为降灾，并打仗和争战的日子所预备的。

verses.en: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?
verses.zh: 光亮从何路分开？东风从何路分散遍地？

words.g: to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively

verses.en: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,
verses.zh: 谁为雨水分道？谁为雷电开路？

verses.en: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,
verses.zh: 使雨降在无人之地、无人居住的旷野？

verses.en: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?
verses.zh: 使荒废凄凉之地得以丰足，青草得以发生？

words.g: a going forth, i.e.  an egress

verses.en: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?
verses.zh: 雨有父吗？露水珠是谁生的呢？

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate

verses.en: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?
verses.zh: 冰出于谁的胎？天上的霜是谁生的呢？

words.g: and + a cover, i.e.  a tankard

verses.en: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.
verses.zh: 诸水坚硬（或译：隐藏）如石头；深渊之面凝结成冰。

verses.en: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?
verses.zh: 你能系住昴星的结吗？能解开参星的带吗？

words.g: a cluster of stars, i.e. the Pleiades

verses.en: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?
verses.zh: 你能按时领出十二宫吗？能引导北斗和随它的众星（星：原文是子）吗？

words.g: and + the constellation of the Great Bear

verses.en: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?
verses.zh: 你知道天的定例吗？能使地归在天的权下吗？

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?
verses.zh: 你能向云彩扬起声来，使倾盆的雨遮盖你吗？

words.g: (question) + to be high actively, to rise or raise

verses.en: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?
verses.zh: 你能发出闪电，叫它行去，使它对你说：我们在这里？

verses.en: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?
verses.zh: 谁将智慧放在怀中？谁将聪明赐于心内？

verses.en: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,
verses.zh: 谁能用智慧数算云彩呢？尘土聚集成团，土块紧紧结连；那时，谁能倾倒天上的瓶呢？

words.g: to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe

verses.en: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?
verses.zh: a

words.g: to impinge, i.e. cling or adhere

verses.en: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
verses.zh: 母狮子在洞中蹲伏，少壮狮子在隐密处埋伏；你能为它们抓取食物，使它们饱足吗？

verses.en: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?
verses.zh: a

verses.en: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
verses.zh: 乌鸦之雏因无食物飞来飞去，哀告神；那时，谁为它预备食物呢？

words.g: something born, i.e. a lad or offspring + +him/his/it
to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray
to + failure, i.e. nothing or destruction

verses.en: “Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?
verses.zh: 山岩间的野山羊几时生产，你知道吗？母鹿下犊之期，你能察定吗？

words.g: a craggy rock, literally or figuratively
to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance

verses.en: Can you count the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?
verses.zh: 它们怀胎的月数，你能数算吗？它们几时生产，你能晓得吗？

words.g: to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe

verses.en: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains.
verses.zh: 它们屈身，将子生下，就除掉疼痛。

words.g: something born, i.e. a lad or offspring + +them/their
to slice, i.e. break open or pierce
a rope , especially a measuring line + +them/their

verses.en: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.
verses.zh: 这子渐渐肥壮，在荒野长大，去而不回。

words.g: to bind firmly, i.e.  to be  plump

verses.en: “Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,
verses.zh: 谁放野驴出去自由？谁解开快驴的绳索？

verses.en: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?
verses.zh: 我使旷野作它的住处，使咸地当它的居所。

verses.en: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.
verses.zh: 它嗤笑城内的喧嚷，不听赶牲口的喝声。

verses.en: The range of the mountains is his pasture. He searches after every green thing.
verses.zh: 遍山是它的草场；它寻找各样青绿之物。

words.g: what is left, i.e.  a gleaning

verses.en: “Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough?
verses.zh: 野牛岂肯服事你？岂肯住在你的槽旁？

words.g: (question) + to breathe after, i.e.  to be acquiescent
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?
verses.zh: 你岂能用套绳将野牛笼在犁沟之间？它岂肯随你耙山谷之地？

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor?
verses.zh: 岂可因它的力大就倚靠它？岂可把你的工交给它做吗？

verses.en: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?
verses.zh: 岂可信靠它把你的粮食运到家，又收聚你禾场上的谷吗？

verses.en: “The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the feathers and plumage of love?
verses.zh: 鸵鸟的翅膀欢然搧展，岂是显慈爱的翎毛和羽毛吗？

words.g: to leap for joy, i.e. exult
used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
the kind  bird, i.e. a stork

verses.en: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,
verses.zh: 因它把蛋留在地上，在尘土中使得温暖；

verses.en: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild animal may trample them.
verses.zh: 却想不到被脚踹碎，或被野兽践踏。

words.g: and + to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of

verses.en: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,
verses.zh: 它忍心待雏，似乎不是自己的；虽然徒受劳苦，也不为雏惧怕；

verses.en: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.
verses.zh: 因为神使它没有智慧，也未将悟性赐给它。

verses.en: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.
verses.zh: 它几时挺身展开翅膀，就嗤笑马和骑马的人。

verses.en: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?
verses.zh: 马的大力是你所赐的吗？它颈项上挓挲的鬃是你给它披上的吗？

verses.en: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.
verses.zh: 是你叫它跳跃像蝗虫吗？它喷气之威使人惊惶。

words.g: the + to undulate , particularly through fear + +him/his/it

verses.en: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.
verses.zh: 它在谷中刨地，自喜其力；它出去迎接佩带兵器的人。

words.g: and + to be bright, i.e. cheerful

verses.en: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.
verses.zh: 它嗤笑可怕的事并不惊惶，也不因刀剑退回。

verses.en: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.
verses.zh: 箭袋和发亮的枪，并短枪在它身上铮铮有声。

words.g: and + something to strike with, i.e. a dart

verses.en: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.
verses.zh: 它发猛烈的怒气将地吞下；一听角声就不耐站立。

verses.en: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
verses.zh: 角每发声，它说呵哈；它从远处闻着战气，又听见军长大发雷声和兵丁呐喊。

words.g: in + enough , used chiefly with preposition in phrases
and + from + remote, literally or figuratively
and + clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry

verses.en: “Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?
verses.zh: 鹰雀飞翔，展开翅膀一直向南，岂是藉你的智慧吗？

verses.en: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?
verses.zh: 大鹰上腾在高处搭窝，岂是听你的吩咐吗？

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +you/your
to be high actively, to rise or raise
a nest , sometimes including the nestlings + +him/his/it

verses.en: On the cliff he dwells and makes his home, on the point of the cliff and the stronghold.
verses.zh: 它住在山岩，以山峰和坚固之所为家，

words.g: a craggy rock, literally or figuratively
a craggy rock, literally or figuratively

verses.en: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.
verses.zh: 从那里窥看食物，眼睛远远观望。

words.g: to + from + remote, literally or figuratively

verses.en: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”
verses.zh: 它的雏也咂血；被杀的人在哪里，它也在那里。

words.g: and + the brood of a bird + +him/his/it

verses.en: Moreover the LORD answered Job,
verses.zh: 耶和华又对约伯说：

words.g: Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience

verses.en: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
verses.zh: 强辩的岂可与全能者争论吗？与神辩驳的可以回答这些吧！

verses.en: Then Job answered the LORD,
verses.zh: 于是，约伯回答耶和华说：

words.g: Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience

verses.en: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
verses.zh: 我是卑贱的！我用甚么回答你呢？只好用手捂口。

words.g: the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +me/my

verses.en: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
verses.zh: 我说了一次，再不回答；说了两次，就不再说。

verses.en: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind:
verses.zh: 于是，耶和华从旋风中回答约伯说：

words.g: Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience

verses.en: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.
verses.zh: 你要如勇士束腰；我问你，你可以指示我。

words.g: like + a valiant man or warrior

verses.en: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
verses.zh: 你岂可废弃我所拟定的？岂可定我有罪，好显自己为义吗？

words.g: to break up , i.e. to violate

verses.en: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
verses.zh: 你有神那样的膀臂吗？你能像他发雷声吗？

words.g: and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as + +him/his/it
to tumble, i.e. be violently agitated

verses.en: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
verses.zh: 你要以荣耀庄严为妆饰，以尊荣威严为衣服；

words.g: to advance, i.e. pass on or continue
and + magnificence, i.e. ornament or splendor

verses.en: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
verses.zh: 要发出你满溢的怒气，见一切骄傲的人，使他降卑；

words.g: to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively

verses.en: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
verses.zh: 见一切骄傲的人，将他制伏，把恶人践踏在本处；

words.g: and + to crush with the foot

verses.en: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.
verses.zh: 将他们一同隐藏在尘土中，把他们的脸蒙蔽在隐密处；

verses.en: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.
verses.zh: 我就认你右手能以救自己。

words.g: to be open, wide or free

verses.en: “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.
verses.zh: 你且观看河马；我造你也造它。它吃草与牛一样；

words.g: a water-ox, i.e. the hippopotamus or Nile-horse

verses.en: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.
verses.zh: 它的气力在腰间，能力在肚腹的筋上。

words.g: in + the waist or small of the back + +him/his/it

verses.en: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
verses.zh: 它摇动尾巴如香柏树；它大腿的筋互相联络。

words.g: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as

verses.en: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.
verses.zh: 它的骨头好像铜管；它的肢体彷佛铁棍。

verses.en: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.
verses.zh: 它在神所造的物中为首；创造它的给它刀剑。

verses.en: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.
verses.zh: 诸山给它出食物，也是百兽游玩之处。

verses.en: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.
verses.zh: 它伏在莲叶之下，卧在芦苇隐密处和水洼子里。

verses.en: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.
verses.zh: 莲叶的阴凉遮蔽它；溪旁的柳树环绕它。

words.g: a stream, especially a winter torrent

verses.en: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.
verses.zh: 河水泛滥，它不发战；就是约旦河的水涨到它口边，也是安然。

words.g: to start up suddenly, i.e.  to hasten away
to gush forth , generally to issue

verses.en: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?
verses.zh: 在它防备的时候，谁能捉拿它？谁能牢笼它穿它的鼻子呢？

verses.en: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?
verses.zh: 你能用鱼钩钓上鳄鱼吗？能用绳子压下它的舌头吗？

words.g: to draw, used in a great variety of applications
a wreathed animal, i.e. a serpent
and + in + a rope , especially a measuring line

verses.en: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?
verses.zh: 你能用绳索穿它的鼻子吗？能用钩穿它的腮骨吗？

verses.en: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?
verses.zh: 它岂向你连连恳求，说柔和的话吗？

words.g: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!

verses.en: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?
verses.zh: 岂肯与你立约，使你拿它永远作奴仆吗？

verses.en: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?
verses.zh: 你岂可拿它当雀鸟玩耍吗？岂可为你的幼女将它拴住吗？

words.g: and + to tie, physically  or mentally + +him/his/it

verses.en: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?
verses.zh: 搭伙的渔夫岂可拿它当货物吗？能把它分给商人吗？

words.g: to cut or split in two + +him/his/it
a Kenaanite or inhabitant of Kenaan

verses.en: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?
verses.zh: 你能用倒钩枪扎满它的皮，能用鱼叉叉满它的头吗？

words.g: and + in + a clatter, i.e.  whirring

verses.en: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.
verses.zh: 你按手在它身上，想与它争战，就不再这样行吧！

verses.en: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?
verses.zh: 人指望捉拿它是徒然的；一见它，岂不丧胆吗？

verses.en: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?
verses.zh: 没有那么凶猛的人敢惹它。这样，谁能在我面前站立得住呢？

verses.en: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.
verses.zh: 谁先给我甚么，使我偿还呢？天下万物都是我的。

verses.en: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.
verses.zh: 论到鳄鱼的肢体和其大力，并美好的骨骼，我不能缄默不言。

verses.en: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?
verses.zh: 谁能剥它的外衣？谁能进它上下牙骨之间呢？

verses.en: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.
verses.zh: 谁能开它的腮颊？它牙齿四围是可畏的。

words.g: something swinging, i.e. the valve of adoor

verses.en: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.
verses.zh: 它以坚固的鳞甲为可夸，紧紧合闭，封得严密。

verses.en: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
verses.zh: 这鳞甲一一相连，甚至气不得透入其间，

verses.en: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.
verses.zh: 都是互相联络、胶结，不能分离。

words.g: to impinge, i.e. cling or adhere
to break through, i.e. spread or separate

verses.en: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
verses.zh: 它打喷嚏就发出光来；它眼睛好像早晨的光线（原文是眼皮）。

verses.en: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.
verses.zh: 从它口中发出烧着的火把，与飞迸的火星；

something struck off, i.e. a spark
to be smooth, i.e.  to escape

verses.en: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.
verses.zh: 从它鼻孔冒出烟来，如烧开的锅和点着的芦苇。

verses.en: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.
verses.zh: 它的气点着煤炭，有火焰从它口中发出。

words.g: from + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +him/his/it

verses.en: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.
verses.zh: 它颈项中存着劲力；在它面前的都恐吓蹦跳。

words.g: in + the back of the neck + +him/his/it

verses.en: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.
verses.zh: 它的肉块互相联络，紧贴其身，不能摇动。

words.g: to impinge, i.e. cling or adhere

verses.en: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.
verses.zh: 它的心结实如石头，如下磨石那样结实。

words.g: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as

verses.en: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.
verses.zh: 它一起来，勇士都惊恐，心里慌乱，便都昏迷。

words.g: from + an elevation or leprous scab + +him/his/it
to turn aside from the road , i.e. sojourn

verses.en: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.
verses.zh: 人若用刀，用枪，用标枪，用尖枪扎它，都是无用。

verses.en: He counts iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.
verses.zh: 它以铁为干草，以铜为烂木。

words.g: to + material, i.e.  refuse haum or stalks of grain

verses.en: The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.
verses.zh: 箭不能恐吓它使它逃避；弹石在它看为碎秸。

words.g: a bow, forshooting  or the iris

verses.en: Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.
verses.zh: 棍棒算为禾秸；它嗤笑短枪飕的响声。

words.g: something to strike with, i.e. a dart

verses.en: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.
verses.zh: 它肚腹下如尖瓦片；它如钉耙经过淤泥。

verses.en: He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.
verses.zh: 它使深渊开滚如锅，使洋海如锅中的膏油。

verses.en: He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.
verses.zh: 它行的路随后发光，令人想深渊如同白发。

verses.en: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.
verses.zh: 在地上没有像它造的那样，无所惧怕。

words.g: to + failure, i.e. nothing or destruction

verses.en: He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”
verses.zh: 凡高大的，它无不藐视；它在骄傲的水族上作王。

verses.en: Then Job answered the LORD:
verses.zh: 约伯回答耶和华说：

words.g: Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience

verses.en: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.
verses.zh: 我知道，你万事都能做；你的旨意不能拦阻。

verses.en: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand, things too wonderful for me, which I didn’t know.
verses.zh: 谁用无知的言语使你的旨意隐藏呢？我所说的是我不明白的；这些事太奇妙，是我不知道的。

words.g: to veil from sight, i.e. conceal

verses.en: You said, ‘Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.’
verses.zh: 求你听我，我要说话；我问你，求你指示我。

verses.en: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.
verses.zh: 我从前风闻有你，现在亲眼看见你。

words.g: to + something heard, i.e. a sound

verses.en: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”
verses.zh: 因此我厌恶自己（或译：我的言语），在尘土和炉灰中懊悔。

verses.en: It was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words to Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.
verses.zh: 耶和华对约伯说话以后，就对提幔人以利法说：「我的怒气向你和你两个朋友发作，因为你们议论我不如我的仆人约伯说的是。

verses.en: Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.”
verses.zh: 现在你们要取七只公牛，七只公羊，到我仆人约伯那里去，为自己献上燔祭，我的仆人约伯就为你们祈祷。我因悦纳他，就不按你们的愚妄办你们。你们议论我，不如我的仆人约伯说的是。」

verses.zh: 于是提幔人以利法、书亚人比勒达、拿玛人琐法照着耶和华所吩咐的去行；耶和华就悦纳约伯。

verses.en: The LORD restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. The LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.
verses.zh: 约伯为他的朋友祈祷。耶和华就使约伯从苦境（原文是掳掠）转回，并且耶和华赐给他的比他从前所有的加倍。

verses.en: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the evil that the LORD had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.
verses.zh: 约伯的弟兄、姊妹，和以先所认识的人都来见他，在他家里一同吃饭；又论到耶和华所降与他的一切灾祸，都为他悲伤安慰他。每人也送他一块银子和一个金环。

verses.en: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.
verses.zh: 这样，耶和华后来赐福给约伯比先前更多。他有一万四千羊，六千骆驼，一千对牛，一千母驴。

words.g: Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience

verses.en: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
verses.zh: 他也有七个儿子，三个女儿。

verses.en: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.
verses.zh: 他给长女起名叫耶米玛，次女叫基洗亚，三女叫基连・哈朴。

verses.en: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job. Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.
verses.zh: 在那全地的妇女中找不着像约伯的女儿那样美貌。她们的父亲使她们在弟兄中得产业。

words.g: Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience
father, in a literal and immediate + +them/their

verses.en: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.
verses.zh: 此后，约伯又活了一百四十年，得见他的儿孙，直到四代。

verses.en: So Job died, being old and full of days.
verses.zh: 这样，约伯年纪老迈，日子满足而死。
